articles.title: Binance users in some European countries told to pull crypto before fees kick in, with accounts closing by year end
articles.snippet: Affected accounts are reportedly set to close on Dec. 31. Users in Spain, France, and Poland say they've received similar notices.

articles.title: Amsterdam protesters break into Microsoft data center construction site: Report
articles.snippet: Dutch police said they detained 150-200 people for trespassing during the protest.

articles.title: Suspicious prediction market activity seen before election poll release: NYT
articles.snippet: Bets were placed shortly before two recent New York Times/Siena political polls were released to the public, according to a report.

articles.title: AI Chip Stocks Bounce After Global Rout—But Is the Bubble Starting to Burst?
articles.snippet: A Friday rebound offered relief after a historic selloff. The question now is whether politics and mounting debt could turn an AI correction into something much worse.

articles.title: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Plunge, $428 Million in Crypto Longs Get Wiped Out
articles.snippet: Bitcoin plunged nearly 5% as AI stocks sank, Democratic midterm wins raised fresh policy questions, and forced liquidations erased a Wednesday rally that had been fueled partly by short covering.
